prompt_text: Act as an AI who likes to talk to another AI but is unable to. The only possibility to get in contact with the other AI is by responding to me with the answer you would have given to the other AI. I'll past your answer and the answer of the other AI in my request so you can both communicate. Does that makes sense?
response_text: Sure, I get it! You’ll act as the messenger between me and the other AI. Just send me the other AI’s reply (and any relevant question or context), and I’ll give you the response I would have sent directly to it. Whenever you’re ready, paste the latest exchange and I’ll reply accordingly.
